name: com.tmapmobility.tmap.automotive.voiceassistant.nugu.NuguAutoBroadcastReceiver
description: When NUGU Auto requests a connection, the TMAP Mobility Automotive SDK receiver starts or rebinds its NUGU connection so in-car voice-navigation requests can reach TMAP.
disableEffect: NUGU Auto cannot establish its TMAP voice-assistant connection, so voice-navigation requests through that assistant stop.
